Length 0x50 is CONFIRMED_STATIC (decompiled constant in FUN_080a1370/FUN_080a13f0); samples cannot distinguish lengths 0x14..0x60 because bytes +0x14..+0x5F are zero.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Fill header bytes 0x0050..0x005F with 0xAA, no checksum repair; separately set tail 0x0062..0x0063 to 0xFFFF
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: If covered length 0x50 is correct, header still validates and bytes persist with no recreation; any recreation falsifies 0x50 in favour of 0x60. Persistence plus a visible change would reveal an untraced reader of the unchecksummed tail.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Change header u32@+8 from 0x00030115 to 0x00030116 WITH header checksum repair at 0x0060
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: FUN_080a1370 still rejects (the +8 compare is independent of checksum) and the header is recreated to the original template - proving +8 is an identity gate, not data, and confirming ROM template values without reading _DAT_ tables. Same method applies to u16@+0xC at offset 12.

fuzzing_targets.mutation: Boot with an all-0xFF 32768-byte image (counterfactual whole-image test)
fuzzing_targets.predicted_effect: Boot chain prediction: SRAM probe succeeds, all five validators fail, all five creators run, producing exactly the observed layout (header template at 0x0 with checksum 0xA990, zero blocks at the proposed offsets, 0xFF elsewhere). Any additional written region reveals a block missed by the traced set.

open_questions: Exact SRAM file offsets of blocks B (100 B), C (36 B), and the D/E order at 0x70F8/0x710C: all destinations are *_DAT_ + _DAT_ expressions whose values are not in the workspace. Proposed layout (B@0x7038, C@0x709C, D@0x70F8, E@0x710C) rests on size fits 100+36=136 and 20+20=40 plus creator zero-fill; B/C and D/E orders are interchangeable on current evidence. A single runtime watchpoint on FUN_080a12a0 (address+length args) or fuzzing target 7 settles it.

36-byte block checksum anomaly: FUN_080a1e50/FUN_080a1ea8 pass length 0x24 to FUN_080a1344 while storing at +0x22, putting the stored word inside the summed range as decompiled. True length is probably 0x22 (decompiler constant error) or the check is vestigial for the only-ever-zero payload; all-zero samples cannot discriminate. Fuzzing target 6 settles it.

No fixed EWRAM/IWRAM (0x02xxxxxx/0x03xxxxxx) mirror can be named for any field: all traced save buffers are stack buffers and every _DAT_ pointer value is unresolved in ghidra/decompiled.c. Whether a persistent RAM mirror exists outside the traced functions is unknown.

func_0x080c11a4 (and neighbours 0x080c1198-0x080c11b0) are unrecovered 4-byte trampolines: read role is inferred from call sites, but its exact prototype, 4th argument, and return semantics (0 = success in FUN_080c1124; ignored by validators) are UNKNOWN. Likewise FUN_080c1000's *_DAT_080c1038 |= 3 register (candidate WAITCNT 0x04000204) and FUN_080a121c's *_DAT_080a127c |= 0x2000 register are unidentified.

FUN_080a1558's seven 16-byte records (base + 100 + idx*16, u16 ID at +4, 7-entry dispatch table): base unresolved, no writer traced, candidate file bytes (0x64+) are 0xFF in both samples. Are these save records at all, and if so where do they live? A watchpoint on its func_0x080c11a4 call (fuzzing target in report section 6, #10) settles it.

FUN_080a01f0: five branch constants for u32@buf+8, the 0x8000-byte second read's source/destination, and all 0x0809fxxx branch callees are outside the traced evidence. Its erase (FUN_080a1308) + SRAM re-probe (FUN_080a121c) calls make it save-adjacent, but its purpose (import/transfer/factory path?) is UNKNOWN.

FUN_080a1308 erase span: base (*piVar1) and chunk count (_DAT_080a1340) unresolved, so which part of the 0xFF regions it can clear is UNKNOWN. Fuzzing target 4 (magic corruption) observes it indirectly.

Semantics of almost every payload field are unknown within clean-room rules: header u16@+0xC (0x200A), flags u32@+0x10 (0xE0000000, only top-byte bits survive masking), the 12 counted bytes at +0x14 (what sets them - no traced writer sets them non-zero), both bit arrays' bit meanings (only bit 90 is observed set, via idx<0x80 setter FUN_08003e04), and blocks B/C payloads (never non-zero in this cohort).

Post-creation writers for blocks A, B, C, E were not found in the 291 traced functions (only creators, plus FUN_080a24b8 for one bits20 block). Either updates live in untraced code or these blocks are write-once in this beta; the trace-guided corpus cannot distinguish these.

The two save_related_functions.c seeds (0x080c126c, 0x080c1424) are signed divide/remainder routines, not save/MMIO functions; why the seed extractor flagged them, and whether a true Flash/EEPROM driver exists in untraced ROM code (none is in the traced set - zero hits for 0x5555/0x2AAA/0x040000D4 literals), remains open. Media identification as SRAM rests on PACKET.md, the 32768-byte size, and the byte-copy+verify driver shape.

Checksum covered length for header A: algorithm and stored value are CONFIRMED_VERIFIED, but bytes +0x14..+0x5F are all zero in both samples, so lengths 0x14..0x60 are sample-indistinguishable; 0x50 rests on the decompiled constant (CONFIRMED_STATIC). Fuzzing target 8 (mutate 0x0050..0x005F) settles it.
